script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. MODERN Yoga STUDIO - DAY

A bustling yoga studio filled with students, all bending, stretching, and breathing in unison. In the back, YOGI MADAN, 40s, charismatic, dressed in white, leads the class.

YOGI MADAN
(speaking to the class)
Focus on your breath, on your ambition. Let the world around you melt away.

INT. YOGI MADAN'S OFFICE - LATER

Yogi Madan sits behind a cluttered desk, contemplating a stack of mail. SARA, 30s, a dedicated yoga student and businesswoman, enters.

SARA
Hi, Yogi. I wanted to talk to you about the upcoming retreat.

YOGI MADAN
(looking up, smiling)
Ah, the annual retreat. A wonderful opportunity for our students to grow and deepen their practice. What's on your mind, Sara?

SARA
I've been thinking, why not expand our reach? Make the retreat accessible to more people?

YOGI MADAN
(leaning back in his chair)
That's an ambitious thought, Sara. But why limit ourselves? Let's explore the possibilities.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Sara and Yogi Madan sit in a cozy corner booth, sipping coffee and brainstorming ideas for the retreat expansion.

SARA
We could offer scholarships, partner with local schools and community centers.

YOGI MADAN
(nods)
Excellent. And we could live-stream parts of the retreat to reach even more people.

INT. YOGI MADAN'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Yogi Madan sits at his laptop, researching retreat expansion strategies. He comes across an article about a similar retreat and feels discouraged.

YOGI MADAN
(whispering to himself)
Another retreat offering the same thing. How do we stand out?

INT. YOGI MADAN'S OFFICE - DAY

Sara and Yogi Madan gather their students for an announcement.

YOGI MADAN
(smiling)
I have some exciting news to share with all of you. Our annual retreat will not only be bigger and better than ever but also more accessible to people from all walks of life.

INT. YOGA STUDIO - DAY

Students practice, energized by the news of the expanded retreat. Yogi Madan and Sara work tirelessly to make it a success.

INT. COMMUNITY CENTER - NIGHT

The retreat kicks off with a live-streamed opening ceremony, attended by students from around the world. Yogi Madan delivers a heartfelt speech.

YOGI MADAN
(tearfully)
Our ambition is not just to teach yoga but to create a community, a sanctuary for growth and self-discovery.

INT. RETREAT VENUE - DAY

Students participate in various workshops, sharing their experiences and learning from one another.

INT. YOGI MADAN'S OFFICE - LATER

Sara and Yogi Madan reflect on the success of the retreat.

SARA
It's been incredible. We've reached so many people.

YOGI MADAN
Yes, but remember, the real success is in the growth and transformation of our students.

INT. YOGA STUDIO - DAY

As the students leave their mats, they share stories of their retreat experiences, their lives forever changed by their yoga practice and their newfound community.

YOGI MADAN
(to himself)
Our work is never done. Let's continue to ambition to grow, to help others grow.

FADE OUT.
